description: Canonical human-readable names for every visual in the developer sign gallery, keyed by app sign id and by official Schedule designation. Primary source is the table in Section 8 of the Nova Scotia Traffic Signs Regulations (N.S. Reg. 165/2012, amended to N.S. Reg. 178/2023), snapshot data/sources/snapshots/ns-reg-traffic-signs.txt. Where that table gives one name to a group of designations (lane control, turn control, parking, roundabout, crosswalk L/R pairs) the shared official name is narrowed by the movement or orientation actually depicted in the Schedule artwork. Handbook wording (data/sources/snapshots/ns-handbook-ch3.txt) is preferred where the Handbook names the same sign for learners. Names normalise into the visual approval fingerprint, so a material wording change forces re-review — see docs/SIGN_NAME_AUDIT.md.
